notes.title: Patch 1.03 - Teleport, In-Game Menu, Improved Red dots etc
notes.content:
New features

- Allow teleport before shooting started.  Have the laser pointed to the ground, press the trigger button to teleport.

- Press menu button to open the in-game menu.  You can now click next, restart, go to main menu or quit DrillsVR using the in-game menu.

- Improved Red dot sights.  In the in-game menu, you can choose whether your red dot sights will be the left eye or right eye zero'ed.

-  New languages.   Language will have defaulted to your Windows language.  However, you can choose another language in the main menu.   More new languages will come.

- other minor bug fixes included.
